To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we have obtained the (anti-)BRS symmetry transformations for Kμ and B0i by using the (anti-)ghost fields (cμ, c0i, cμ, c0j, c0μ, cμ0, and cμ0i) which have been constructed in a novel way; (ii) we have also obtained the corresponding anti-BRST invariant action (SABR) for the theory under consideration; (iii) we have observed that
the 1-form (Kμ) as well as the 2-form (B0i ) fields are (anti-)BRS t invariant under the (anti-) BRST symmetry transformations that are not generated by their respective (anti-)BR S t charges.
the 1-form and the 2-form gauge theories are not completely symmetric in the context of BRST formalism.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the (anti-) BRST symmetry transformations and the corresponding charges in the context of a 4D topologically massive non -Abelian 2 -form gauge theory.
the study of the (anti-) BRST and (anti-)co-BRST symmetry structures in the context of the topologically massive 4D non-Abelian dynamical 2-form gauge theories.
the study of the nontrivial structure of the BRST symmetry transformations in the context of non-Abelian topologically massive 2-form gauge field theory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our present analysis of 4D topologically massive nonAbelian 2-gauge theory is quite distinct from all the previous applications of BRST symmetry transformations to the (non-)Abesian 1-form and (Abelian) 2-form gauge theories.
the BRST formalisms for the 1-form and the 2-form non-Abelian dynamical theories are not identical in nature.
the BRST and anti-BRBT symmetries for the non-Abelian topologically massive 2-form gauge field theory are not generated by a pair of nilpotent charges.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the BRST formalisms are not universal in the sense that they are not applicable to all the non-Abelian field theories.
we have observed that the (anti)BRST symmetry transformations of the auxiliary fields (Kμ) as well as (B0i), in the present theory, are generated by the anti-BRST and BRST charges, respectively.

we have observed that, in general, the (anti-) BRST symmetry transformations for all the fields of an arbitrary gauge theory may not be generated by the (Anti-) BRST charges which can be obtained by exploiting all the (Anti-)BRST symmetry transformation laws corresponding to all the relevant fields of the theory.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the auxiliary field Kμ is not a genuine gauge field of the present theory because the corresponding BRST symmetry transformation does not originate from the BRST charge.
the (anti)-BRST symmetry transformations of the 1-form field and 2-form potential are not generated by (anti-)BRSt charges.
the (anti)BRST charges are generated from the (anti-) BRST symmetry transformations of the fields that are not the auxiliary fields.
